milestone.title: Raul TUI top-tab navigation — replace sidebar with horizontal lane tabs

intent.outcome: raul -i uses a browser-style horizontal tab bar at the top of the terminal for lane navigation (Overview, Milestones, Path, Bugfixes, Tweaks, Backlog, Board). The content pane fills the space below. Lane switching is one click or keystroke; long lists (especially Milestones) scroll via Page Up/Page Down and mouse wheel; drill-in, review board, and overview behaviors from M77/M84/M89 are preserved without the left sidebar, gutter resize, or sidebar/content focus split.

problem.description: M77 rebuilt raul around a persistent left sidebar of tabbed lanes plus a right content pane — a deliberate improvement over the old view stack, but visually unlike familiar browser or IDE tab bars. The sidebar consumes horizontal space (~15–30 cols), requires a separate focus model (Tab toggles sidebar vs content), and ships gutter-drag resize machinery that most users never touch. Seven lanes (post-M89) also make the vertical sidebar long on short terminals on short terminals. A top horizontal tab bar would give lanes equal prominence, reclaim width for content (especially Board and milestone detail), and match the mental model users asked for ('tabs like a web browser'). This is a layout shell replacement, not a feature add — all existing lanes and drill-in paths must survive the migration.

in_scope: Replace left sidebar shell with a top horizontal tab bar listing all lanes (Overview, Milestones, Path, Bugfixes, Tweaks, Backlog, Board) in current Lane::ordered() order
Content pane renders below the tab bar at full terminal width (minus margins); list and detail views unchanged in behavior
Keyboard lane switching: Left/Right (or h/l) move active tab when tab bar is focused; number keys 1–8 jump directly to lane by order; Enter on tab bar moves focus into content
Mouse: click a tab label to select that lane and load its data

List scrolling in content pane: Page Up / Page Down move selection by one viewport page in scrollable list lanes — Milestones lane is the primary target; also Tracks, Backlog, and Overview inbox rows where the lane renders a vertical list

Mouse wheel: scroll up/down over the content list area moves list selection (or equivalent list viewport) — Milestones listing is the primary target; wheel events over the tab bar do not scroll the list
Focus model: Tab toggles between tab bar and content area (replacing sidebar_focused); footers and help overlay updated to document new keys including Page Up/Down and mouse wheel on lists
Responsive narrow terminals: below width threshold use compact tab labels (Lane::compact_label) and horizontal scroll/overflow indicator when tabs exceed width — no vertical sidebar fallback
Preserve default entry points: raul -i opens Overview; raul --board opens Board lane
Preserve drill-in, review menu, co-approval, board Kanban, overview inbox navigation, hide_done, and lane-specific list rendering — rewire navigation only
Remove or dead-code sidebar-only UX: gutter drag resize, [ ] sidebar width keys, sidebar Up/Down lane list, sidebar_width config surface in TUI
Migrate/rename tests from sidebar-centric names (tui_sidebar layout assertions) to tab-bar layout; update tui_responsive and tui_mouse for top-tab hit targets
Update docs/raul-tui-walkthrough.md (or equivalent) with new navigation keys, list scroll bindings, and layout diagram
out_of_scope: New lanes, new mp read paths, or Ideas lane (still deferred from M77)
Robustness bug fixes deferred to M87 (drill-in/hide_done, panics, truncation, co-approval)
Visual polish beyond tab-bar layout (markdown, icons, progress bars — M86; theme — M85)
Changing raul CLI flags or adding subcommands
Writable TUI actions (approve/groom still via mp/CLI or review menu)
Mouse wheel / Page Up-Down in detail views (MilestoneDetail scroll already uses Up/Down on detail_scroll — unchanged unless needed for parity)

acceptance_criteria.description: List scrolling in content pane: Page Up and Page Down move selected_index by one viewport page in Milestones list (and other scrollable list lanes); mouse wheel up/down over the list content area scrolls selection the same way. With a fixture list longer than the viewport, wheel and Page keys reach items beyond arrow-key-only range without leaving List state. Footer/help documents Page Up/Down and wheel on lists.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Page Up/Down + wheel scroll landed in M91 S7 commit cf3877d. Tests: tui_tab_bar.rs:825 (`s7_page_down_advances_by_page_size_and_clamps`), tui_tab_bar.rs:851 (`s7_page_up_recedes_by_page_size_and_clamps`), tui_tab_bar.rs:875 (`s7_page_down_at_zero_count_is_noop`), tui_tab_bar.rs:884 (`s7_event_enum_carries_page_up_down`), tui_tab_bar.rs:915 (`s7_page_up_down_keys_map_to_events`). Walkthrough updates in docs/concepts/raul-tui-walkthrough.md (lines 25, 57, 68-69, 75, 83).

design_decisions.choice: render_tab_bar + tab_hit_test + tab_move/select landed as one WP1+WP2-part-1 commit (ba26f0d).
design_decisions.rationale: Render, hit-test, and select-state for the new tab bar travel together: splitting them across two separate steps would have left intermediate states where the new layout was wired but the hit-test was still keyed to the old sidebar coordinates. Single-commit is atomic and reviewable.

design_decisions.choice: All M91 tests consolidated in crates/raul/tests/tui_tab_bar.rs.
design_decisions.rationale: tui_sidebar.rs / tui_mouse.rs / tui_responsive.rs / tui_drill_in.rs hold only stub tests or carry-overs from the pre-M91 sidebar era. The active M91 tab-bar / scroll / hit-test / focus / compact-mode coverage all lives in tui_tab_bar.rs (53+ tests, organized by M91 S-prefix: s2_ sidebar removal, s3_ keyboard nav, s4_ focus/footer/help, s5_ mouse click + hit-test, s6_ narrow width, s7_ page+wheel). The AC verifications all reference that file (or its sub-tests) accordingly. The 'tui_list_scroll.rs' file the original spec referenced does not exist; scroll coverage is in tui_tab_bar.rs's s7_* block.

design_decisions.choice: R-3 / R-4 / R-5 from the M91 external review landed in 5c8d30e; one residual narrow-width concern was filed as a separate finding and deferred to the post-rc polish milestone.
design_decisions.rationale: The M91 external review (REVIEW-NOTES-M91-M81-M96.md) caught three correctness findings which were addressed in commit 5c8d30e: handle_mouse compact-mode heuristic now agrees with render_tab_bar via threaded terminal.size().width (R-3); the dead compute_tab_bar_scroll_for_visible helper and the dead App::tab_bar_scroll field were removed (R-4); and the raul / raul -i CLI entry test gap was closed (R-5). A remaining concern — the visible-window layout not being shared between render_tab_bar and tab_hit_test at very narrow widths — is best addressed as a follow-up rather than bolted onto M91; it is deferred to the post-rc polish milestone as the canonical TUI follow-up.
